status: development, exposed (D-713, document review half): the measurement config of the two reasoning methods; not shipped, nothing launched
note: D-713: the two choice forms of choice_judge_prompt.json byte for byte, asked by three groups on one model: choice_direct (the form itself), choice_reason_first and choice_stepwise (benchmark/baselines/reasoning_methods.py). The label step of each method is decided over the form's own answers, so the classes and the scorer are the form's. The file's document template and outcomes are never sent.

pair.template:
Two passages from one document follow.

PASSAGE A
{passage_a}

PASSAGE B
{passage_b}

Do the two passages contradict each other, so that both cannot be true of the same thing at the same time? Passages about different things, different times or different people do not contradict each other.

Answer with one word.
Yes: they contradict each other.
No: they do not.
Unclear: the two passages do not let you decide.

comparison.template:
Two quotes from one document follow.

QUOTE A
{quote_a}

QUOTE B
{quote_b}

How do the two quotes stand to each other?

Answer with one word.
Agree: both can be true of the same thing at the same time.
Conflict: both cannot be true of the same thing at the same time.
Unrelated: they speak of different things, times or people.

answers.label: conflict
